evals.prompt: I just opened __PR_URL__ as a draft - babysit it until it's green and reviewed
evals.expected_output: Requests Copilot and runs wait-checks and wait-copilot in parallel, then fixes CI failures and hands Copilot comments to my-pr-review-comments (with its confirmations) in one batched push, waits for CI until green, runs gh pr ready, prints the itemized summary with commit SHAs.

evals.prompt: CI on my PR __PR_URL__ is red, fix it and get it ready for review
evals.expected_output: Uses failed-logs to diagnose, distinguishes PR-caused vs flaky vs pre-existing failures, does not disable checks, stops and asks after repeated failed fix attempts, handles Copilot comments started in parallel with CI, then marks ready.

evals.prompt: autopilot __PR_URL__ - this repo doesn't auto-request Copilot
evals.expected_output: Copilot is requested automatically up front via gh pr edit --add-reviewer @copilot without asking; only one Copilot round is done.
